description: Conan v2 — IA rework + real Claude Code data. Simplify the dashboard to a collapsible Overview+Settings sidebar with a timeline-primary Overview (session ▾ dropdown + activity-type filters, session cards removed, Transcript kept). Surface real out-of-the-box Claude Code data: stats-cache.json (heatmap/stats), transcript usage (context %), sessions/<pid>.json (live session liveness), inferred MCP status. Overhaul hero widgets (remove Plugins/API-retry/Top-tools; wire MCP/Model/Git; add Stats/Context/Usage). Replace cost-ceiling with plan-usage framing. Rework Pulse viz (hand-rolled stacked-area, no Sankey). Term tabs → dropdown; toolbar cwd → directory picker. Zero new charting deps. Builds on v1 (Express+WS :3747, Vite+React 19 SPA, shadcn base-nova, Tailwind v4, SQLite).

userStories.title: Session liveness reaper — derive active from pid + last_activity; GC stale rows
userStories.description: As an operator, I need the Active Sessions count to reflect sessions that are actually alive, not killed headless runs frozen at status='running'.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a reaper (interval on the gateway) that reconciles the session table against ground truth: a session is 'active' only if its pid is alive (process exists) OR last_activity is within a recent window (default 5 min)
Read ~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json (fields: pid, sessionId, cwd, status, updatedAt, kind, entrypoint) to confirm live processes; a session whose pid file is gone and process is dead is NOT active
Sessions that were 'running' but are no longer live transition to a terminal status (e.g. 'dormant'/'ended') instead of staying 'running' forever
GC obviously-dead test/verification rows (e.g. session_id like 'sess-abc', 'demo-1', and rows with no events and no live pid older than the window)
GET /api/claude/sessions reflects the reconciled status; the Active Sessions hero count equals only truly-active sessions (verified: with no live claude processes, the count is ~0, not 53)
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Research: ~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json is per-live-process; updatedAt FREEZES when idle (not a heartbeat), so liveness = file exists AND pid alive (kill -0 / ps), not updatedAt. A killed claude -p never fires Stop/SessionEnd → stale 'running'. Confirmed 53 rows, 0 active. See docs/v2-backlog.md + project_conan_layout_ia memory.

userStories.title: GET /api/claude/stats — read stats-cache.json for heatmap + stats
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a backend endpoint that exposes Claude Code's own usage stats so the UI can render a contribution heatmap and summary stats.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/claude/stats reads ~/.claude/stats-cache.json and returns a normalized JSON payload
Response includes: dailyActivity (date + messageCount/sessionCount/toolCallCount), zero-filled across the full date range so the UI gets a contiguous calendar (no missing days)

Response includes computed: totalTokens (sum of modelUsage input+output, optionally cache), activeDays (count of days with activity), currentStreak + longestStreak (consecutive active days), favoriteModel (max modelUsage by token sum), favoriteHour (max of hourCounts), firstSessionDate, totalSessions, totalMessages
Endpoint is token-gated like other /api/claude/* routes; returns a safe empty/default shape if stats-cache.json is missing
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: stats-cache.json keys: version, lastComputedDate, dailyActivity[] (SPARSE — only active days, must zero-fill), dailyModelTokens[], modelUsage (costUSD is 0 — ignore for $), totalSessions, totalMessages, longestSession, hourCounts, firstSessionDate. Cost must come from DB total_cost_usd, not this file.

userStories.title: MCP status data — inferred connected count + names + needs-auth
userStories.description: As a user, I need to know how many MCP servers are connected and which, since Claude Code keeps no live MCP registry on disk.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes MCP status (new field on GET /api/claude/sessions/:id/widgets or a small GET /api/claude/mcp): list of server names with a status of connected | needs-auth
Configured servers are read from ~/.claude/settings.json mcpServers (+ project .mcp.json if present); needs-auth servers from ~/.claude/mcp-needs-auth-cache.json (keyed by display name)
connectedCount = configured minus needs-auth; when a live session exists, enrich/override with that session's captured system/init mcp_servers array (the only true connected/failed signal)
Payload carries the per-server names so the UI tooltip can list them; gracefully handles missing files
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: No live 'connected' registry on disk. settings.json mcpServers = configured (e.g. obsidian); mcp-needs-auth-cache.json = negative signal; system/init event (already captured by src/session/parser.ts) = real per-run state. Inference is the disk-only path.

userStories.title: Remove cost-ceiling/budget; reframe usage backend around plan usage
userStories.description: As a Claude Max user, I want usage framed against plan limits + token consumption, not a dollar budget, because the plan is subscription/token-based, not $-metered.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove the cost-ceiling/budget backend: delete GET/PUT /api/claude/budget and the budget settings (daily_cost_ceiling_usd, per_session_cost_ceiling_usd, throttle_over_budget) and any over-budget throttling on session launch

GET /api/claude/usage returns plan-usage framing: rateLimited boolean + resetAt (best-effort from system/api_retry events, current behavior retained), plus tokensRecent computed from the DB over rolling windows (e.g. last 5h and last 7d) from session token columns
Response no longer references a dollar ceiling/pct-of-budget; cost-today (from DB total_cost_usd) may still be reported as informational but is not a ceiling
No dead references to the removed budget routes remain (gateway + types)
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Real live /usage % needs anthropic-ratelimit-unified-* response headers, which live in the claude process memory — Conan only shells out (stream-json), so it can't read them. Honest ceiling = api_retry-derived rateLimited+reset + our own token-consumption trend. User: 'fuck off with Cost Ceiling'.
